title: Revit Working Library - Worksharing and Links

entries.name: Links
working_guidance: segment by discipline or scope only when it materially improves visibility, ownership or performance
do not mix ordinary modeled geometry into link-control worksets
use governed view/template visibility for fine-grained display rather than worksets alone

entries.name: Temporary and troubleshooting worksets
working_guidance: temporary worksets should be visibly temporary
clean them regularly and before formal issue
do not create personal or user-named worksets

entries.name: Linked model placement and coordination
working_guidance: linked discipline models should use the governed project coordinate basis
link visibility should be controlled intentionally through governed views/templates and high-level workset strategy
link grouping should support unload, isolation, coordination and export workflows
link presence does not itself make the linked source authoritative

entries.name: Authoring session behavior
working_guidance: borrow only the scope required for the current task
synchronize regularly and release ownership frequently
do not directly edit an authoritative central/shared source in a way that bypasses the governed collaboration method
upgrade and recovery actions require backups, validation and explicit responsibility

working_rules: Worksets support ownership, containment and coarse visibility; they are not a substitute for view-template graphics governance.
No personal/user names in reusable workset identities.
Project-specific collaboration mechanics, link authority and coordinate decisions belong in project/BEP configuration when not universally governed.
A linked or federated model may be a reference carrier without becoming the authoritative source for its information.

provenance.migration_note: Workset and collaboration examples retained as non-authoritative working data and aligned to current S6 authority boundaries. Organization, client and project identifiers removed.
